responsibility: Go-specific GCC driver logic that rewrites the final command-line when invoking `gccgo`. It scans decoded options to decide whether Go compilation implies linking against libgo, libgobegin, pthread, math, and shared/static libgcc support; adds defaults such as `-g`, `-fsplit-stack`, and an output file when needed to keep multiple `.go` inputs together; preserves or reorders user-supplied `-l` options around libgo requirements; and handles special cases for profiling, static linking, split-stack targets, and target linker quirks before the generic driver performs the link step.
